text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During summer camp, Eishin Flash senses something in my troubled gaze as I watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When she asks me what's wrong, I respond honestly that I'm trying to remember as much of these last moments as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her how much I love to see her running, which gets us reminiscing about our journey thus far. Eishin Flash confesses that she doesn't want our time to end just yet either.
